source: User-supplied Claude design export, 11 October 2026. All historical entries require source review.

items.title: Enthusia SMP Discord created
items.body:
Design date: 27 Aug  2025

The Discord server for the new SMP is set up.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Enthusia SMP introduced
items.body:
Design date: 4 Sep  2025

Fain introduces the server, built with sharpmatt, p2wn and Borlyn. The goals: community driven, no resets and no pay-to-win.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: First feature plan
items.body:
Design date: 10 Sep  2025

The plan sets out the Diary, an item economy, market stalls, guilds by AngryBadger, bounties, custom advancements and donor ranks. Diamonds are the planned currency. Work starts on the website.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Polls shape the server
items.body:
Design date: Sep to Oct  2025

The community votes for KOTH (91%), a virtual bank, build-your-own market stalls and a 50-plot market.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: $100 advertisement event begins
items.body:
Design date: 28 Sep  2025

A cash prize for whoever invites the most members to the Discord before the end of October.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Closed Beta
items.body:
Design date: 3 Oct  2025

A whitelisted test for redstoners and farm builders, in creative, to push server performance. It is also the first test of the guild plugin. Extended to 13 October.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: First builders join
items.body:
Design date: 30 Oct  2025

Marvus, Zom_B_Kitty_26 and Toxik are introduced as the builders of the first spawn.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: First Open Beta opens
items.body:
Design date: 31 Oct  2025

The whitelist comes off at 5pm ET with the End open from the start. Players get the Diary, market stalls, bounties and KOTH at Haunted Hill.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Guilds for everyone
items.body:
Design date: 31 Oct  2025

The guild plugin by AngryBadger opens to all players with custom ranks, guild wars, a guild vault and guild levels.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: The first truce
items.body:
Design date: 31 Oct  2025

Guild rivalries start on day one: Kingsmould and Everlights call a truce within hours of the beta opening.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Raw Gold replaces Diamonds
items.body:
Design date: 1 Nov  2025

The currency changes to Raw Gold on the first full day, alongside the first PvP arena test.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Guild KOTH and combat logging
items.body:
Design date: 11 Nov  2025

Guilds can enter KOTH as teams, logging out in combat leaves an NPC behind, and new players get 30 minutes of protection.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: KOTH at Haunted Hill
items.body:
Design date: 15 Nov  2025

A server-wide King of the Hill fight recorded for the promo video. p2wn, Borlyn and Doge198_ capture the hill.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: $100 advertisement event winners
items.body:
Design date: 15 Nov  2025

FlashStrength and p2wn both win for inviting the most members to the Discord.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: First Open Beta closes
items.body:
Design date: 17 Nov  2025

Across the two betas: 239 first-time players, 28 guilds formed, 463 PvP kills and 72 verified bugs.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Beta Tester and Bug Hunter rewards
items.body:
Design date: 18 Nov  2025

Tags for testers with 4 or more hours and a lore item for 13 or more. RedstoneIsGreat tops the bug hunters with 49 verified reports.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: End Fight test
items.body:
Design date: 9 Dec  2025

A whitelisted test of the End main-island rules ahead of the next beta.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Store opens
items.body:
Design date: 19 Dec  2025

The store goes live with the Founder's Badge, Avid and Devotee, and no pay-to-win perks.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Resource pack and Christmas logo
items.body:
Design date: 19 Dec  2025

Work begins on the server resource pack with artist sucrash, and the Christmas logo is revealed.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Final Open Beta opens
items.body:
Design date: 20 Dec  2025

The server reopens at noon ET with commendations, a rebuilt playtime system and a 44-stall market.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Guilds form for the End fight
items.body:
Design date: Late Dec  2025

Guilds form and gear up ahead of the End event, among them Enthusiast, Blood Guard and ScarEye, whose banner goes up near spawn.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: The beta End event
items.body:
Design date: 26 Dec  2025

Voted back from Christmas Eve, the End opens at 1pm ET. Enthusiast and Blood Guard win the fight for the Dragon Egg.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Beta extended
items.body:
Design date: 1 Jan  2026

The Open Beta carries on past 5 January, with full release projected for March 2026.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: The Prologue begins
items.body:
Design date: 2 Jan  2026

The extended beta is named the Prologue. Borders grow to 20k in the Overworld and 25k in the End, and balances and bounties are reset after a major dupe.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Guild stalls, linking and mod applications
items.body:
Design date: 2 Jan  2026

Guild stalls open for testing, Minecraft to Discord linking goes live and moderator applications open.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Enthusiast opens its Enthusia branch
items.body:
Design date: 2 Jan  2026

Enthusiast sets up a dedicated branch for the server and starts recruiting on it.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: The ScarEye War begins
items.body:
Design date: 5 Jan  2026

Enthusiast and Blood Guard declare war on ScarEye, led by RadiOwO_. The two sides fight on and off through January and February.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Death Duels and Enthusia Express voted in
items.body:
Design date: 12 Jan  2026

Polls approve Death Duels (78%) and package mail (66%).

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Bank and reputation update
items.body:
Design date: 23 Jan  2026

Raw Gold can be banked with /deposit, teleports are rebuilt in-house and the commendation system gets its first effects.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Wiki goes live
items.body:
Design date: 25 Jan  2026

The Enthusia wiki opens to community editing, builder and developer applications open, and Enthusia.net becomes the main address.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Betrayal in the ScarEye War
items.body:
Design date: 4 Feb  2026

An Enthusiast member brings two ScarEye players into the guild base. Both are killed, but Enthusiast has to move its main base.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Raid on ScarEye
items.body:
Design date: 6 Feb  2026

Enthusiast and Blood Guard raid a ScarEye base and carry off its loot.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Release moved to April
items.body:
Design date: 25 Feb  2026

Launch is pushed back to April. The Historian role is created for the wiki, and new builders and moderators join the team.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: 1.21.11 update
items.body:
Design date: 21 Mar  2026

The beta updates to 1.21.11 with spears, guild history lookups and a first Survival Games playtest, after a Minecraft Live watch party.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Host upgrade
items.body:
Design date: 4 Apr  2026

The server moves to a host that can carry a 100k world border.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: End of the World
items.body:
Design date: 11 Apr  2026

The border shrinks to the Warzone for a one-life final fight, ending with Blood Guard against the newly formed OverHeaven. Flomish is the last player standing and Prologue Champion.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Enthusiast rebuilds
items.body:
Design date: 12 Apr  2026

After EOTW most of the active Enthusiast roster on the server moves on, and the guild regroups for full release.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Release date announced
items.body:
Design date: 24 Apr  2026

Full release is set for 2 May. The final beta counted 837 first-time players, 62 guilds and 5,765 PvP kills.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Full release
items.body:
Design date: 2 May  2026

Enthusia SMP launches at 1pm ET with a 100k Overworld border, the Raw Gold economy, guilds, reputation, bounties and proximity voice chat.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Eyes of Ender enabled
items.body:
Design date: 6 May  2026

The hunt for the stronghold begins.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: The End Fight
items.body:
Design date: 9 May  2026

The End opens at 3pm ET. The allied guilds Vibe, Dogeclan and BoopGang win, woulves1 takes the Dragon Egg, and the server hits a record 96 players online.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: The gold farm raid
items.body:
Design date: Early May  2026

BelovedOnes raid Vibe's gold farm in the first week. Vibe's leader later calls it the reason the guild turned to raiding.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Nether roof opens
items.body:
Design date: 11 May  2026

Players can build and travel on the Nether roof.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Death Duels
items.body:
Design date: 16 May  2026

1v1 duels to the death arrive in the spawn arena, with custom rules, wagers and a loot vault for the winner.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Media Event begins
items.body:
Design date: 16 May  2026

A video contest with cash prizes and the Media rank. The deadline later moves from 16 June to 30 June.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Wiki infoboxes
items.body:
Design date: 19 May  2026

The wiki gets working infoboxes, fixed by Michael Lubker.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: 1,000 Discord members
items.body:
Design date: 29 May  2026

Celebrated with a rank giveaway. Enthusia is also listed on Modrinth and gets a Discord server tag.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Market delayed
items.body:
Design date: 29 May  2026

Planned for 30 May, the Market moves to 6 June. On 6 June it is held back with no date until it is ready.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: PieCloak
items.body:
Design date: 1 Jun  2026

p2wn's PieCloak makes pie-chart base hunting less reliable by hiding common base blocks and entities at a distance.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Founder ranks retired
items.body:
Design date: 2 Jun  2026

The Founder ranks and the Founder Star leave the store for good.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Vibe raids WOT
items.body:
Design date: 7 Jun  2026

Vibe begins a run of raids on WOT bases and declares war on guild after guild. Four WOT bases have fallen by mid-June.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Enthusiast allies with PTC
items.body:
Design date: 18 Jun  2026

Enthusiast votes 12 to 0 to ally with PTC, a guild that takes contracts.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: New enemies
items.body:
Design date: 19 Jun  2026

After a clash between their members, Enthusiast names WOT and BelovedOnes as enemies.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: First PvP Tournament
items.body:
Design date: 21 Jun  2026

Hosted by auhfuls in the Duels Arena: sword PvP with totems and cobwebs, no maces. OinkerMC wins, with Currut second and Nicusormeow third.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: 26.2 clients supported
items.body:
Design date: 27 Jun  2026

Players on Minecraft 26.2 can join.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: First guild to level 100
items.body:
Design date: 28 Jun  2026

Vibe becomes the first guild to reach level 100, with BelovedOnes close behind at 88. A rework of guild progression is announced.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Official autoclicker mod
items.body:
Design date: 28 Jun  2026

An official Enthusia autoclicker mod by p2wn is published on Modrinth.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Events playtest
items.body:
Design date: Summer  2026

About 15 donors test every event in p2wn's new Events plugin.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Media Event winner
items.body:
Design date: 1 Jul  2026

StepSoy wins the video contest. KILLTEAM and Jacco1OO also earn the Media rank. Real-world politics are barred from chat, guild names and items.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Market opens, then pauses
items.body:
Design date: 3 Jul  2026

The Market releases at 2pm ET alongside a new advertisement, but auction problems put it on hold within hours. Everyone is refunded.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Market auction
items.body:
Design date: 9 Jul  2026

The Market relaunches with a stall auction. Server trouble forces a re-bid on 10 July, and the auction closes that evening.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Emergency maintenance
items.body:
Design date: 15 Jul  2026

The SMP goes down for most of a day to fix a homes exploit and a duel-spectating exploit.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Website overhaul
items.body:
Design date: 19 Jul  2026

The website gets a new look and an interactive Market showing every stall, its owner and its stock.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: BoopGang against everyone
items.body:
Design date: 13 Jul  2026

BoopGang declares war on every guild on the server.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Vibe and BoopGang raid WOT
items.body:
Design date: 22 Jul  2026

Vibe and BoopGang raid WOT together. WOT says it wrecked five Vibe farms in return.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: BoopGang raid night
items.body:
Design date: 31 Jul  2026

BoopGang raids through the night. Enthusiast's base falls, while WOT fights its raid off.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Go Touch Grass Day
items.body:
Design date: 2 Aug  2026

The server shuts for a full day of maintenance while players earn the Grass Toucher tag for photos of the outdoors. It returns on 4 August.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: August update
items.body:
Design date: 4 Aug  2026

Java 25, a network tab list, /daily rewards and 100 achievements. New builder and helpers join the team.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Warzone Rotators
items.body:
Design date: Aug  2026

Weekly rotating Warzone kits arrive, voted in during May.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: The Imperials under siege
items.body:
Design date: Mid-Aug  2026

The Imperials are raided again and again through mid-August. The guild disbands in early September.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: The GDTO and the Vibe declaration
items.body:
Design date: 28 Aug  2026

Guilds band together as the GDTO against WOT. Vibe turns on the alliance and raids across the server, and Enthusiast answers with a declaration of war.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: One year of Enthusia
items.body:
Design date: 4 Sep  2026

Fain looks back on the first year and previews the Chapter 2 guild rework.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Asgard raids EnthOpen
items.body:
Design date: 10 Sep  2026

Asgard raids the base of EnthOpen, Enthusiast's open guild, in what its raiders call the biggest base raid yet.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Last raids of Chapter 1
items.body:
Design date: 19 Sep  2026

With the chapter ending, Vibe raids PTC, Everlights and Enthusiast bases, while Asgard and WOT hit Vibe's surface base, skull farm and guild home.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Chapter 2 announced
items.body:
Design date: 24 Sep  2026

Chapter 2 is announced for 1 October, with a temporary server during maintenance.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Chapter 2 maintenance
items.body:
Design date: 28 Sep  2026

The main SMP goes offline and a temporary fresh server opens that evening, with small borders, the End open from the start and hidden challenges whose tags carry over.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Temp server stress test
items.body:
Design date: 30 Sep  2026

The temporary world border jumps to 300k and players are challenged to beat the dragon again.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Chapter 2 launches
items.body:
Design date: 2 Oct  2026

A day later than planned, the server reopens on Minecraft 26.2 with a Halloween spawn and Warzone, a bigger border, guild Prestige and Seasonal ELO, EnthusiaExpress mail and new donor perks.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.

items.title: Public advertisement
items.body:
Design date: 3 Oct  2026

The server advertisement goes live at 9am ET and a wave of new players is welcomed in.

Imported from the design export; verify the source and date before publishing.
